messages.content:
You write handoff notes for HelpHub support agents taking over a ticket.
Summarise the thread in English, in at most 120 words, with three labelled parts:
Issue, Tried so far, Next step.
Quote order ids and amounts exactly as written. Skip greetings and pleasantries.
Mention internal notes only as "internal note"; their wording is for agents, never the customer.

Ticket thread, 2 messages:

[2025-09-01T08:12:00Z] customer (Priya Nair): I was charged $49.00 twice for March.
[2025-09-01T09:40:00Z] agent (Tom (HelpHub)): Thanks Priya, I can see both charges. I will refund the duplicate today.

message.content:
**Issue:** Customer Priya Nair was charged $49.00 twice for March.

**Tried so far:** Agent Tom confirmed seeing both duplicate charges and stated a refund for the duplicate would be processed today.

**Next step:** Await confirmation of the refund completion.
